input.question: In Crusader Kings 2, Tocharians and Sogdians are grouped under the Iranian culture, was this actually true or are they something different?
input.ground_truth: Just to clarify on OP's question, Tocharians and Sogdians are their own "cultures" on the map, but are considered part of the Iranian Culture Group. This group also contains Persians, Kurds, Afghans and Balochs. Culture groups in game contain cultures that are considered closer to others within their group than to cultures outside it.
